court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Rohitkumar Mahavirprasad Sharma And ... vs The State Of Maharashtra And Anr

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Rohitkumar Mahavirprasad Sharma, Sarla Pareshkumar Trivedi, Pareshkumar Rajkishor Trivedi (husband, wife, in-laws)
parties.respondent_defendant: The State of Maharashtra, Rekha Rohitkumar Sharma (wife, state)

facts_of_case: Petitioners seek quashing of FIR bearing C.R. No. I-65 of 2019 registered with the Valiv Police Station, Palghar, for alleged offences punishable under Sections 498A, 406, 323, 504, 506 of the Indian Penal Code. Parties have amicably settled their dispute.

legal_principles.principle: A divorce by mutual consent under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act is allowed.
legal_principles.held: Learned Counsel relied on the judgment and order passed by the learned Judge, Family Court, Mumbai, dated 2nd July, 2021, evidencing the same.
cited_cases: judgment and order passed by the learned Judge, Family Court, Mumbai, (Year)

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking quashing of a FIR to establish that there is no further need for investigation.
legal_principles.held: Not applicable in this case, as the parties have amicably settled their dispute.

outcome.final_order: Quashing of FIR sought is allowed as parties have amicably settled their dispute.

keywords: Latin maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
